title: 丽桑卓·雪花茶杯
description: 高冰冠丽桑卓穿完整深色长袍，端坐在圆椅上端小茶杯，冰晶轮廓柔和而不惊悚。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Lissandra is a tall ice witch with a massive dark pointed crown covering her eyes, pale blue skin, flowing white hair, and a long black-teal gown merging with crystalline ice forms. Preserve her distinctive eyeless crown silhouette and elongated robe, with fully covered torso and arms. Render the ice as soft rounded wax-crayon facets rather than dangerous spikes or threatening frozen victims.
art_direction.scene: She sits on a broad round-backed chair and holds a tiny warm teacup between her pale hands, inclining the heavy crown with quiet interest toward its steam. A low side table carries a simple snowflake-shaped biscuit. Keep the background a pale blue window and one curtain, contrasting her grand icy silhouette with a small cozy ritual.
art_direction.palette: deep teal, icy blue, pearl white, warm cream
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
